search_kinds.by_type_name: Start from the DN type names in type_list.csv and synonyms.csv and search for activation experiments type by type.
search_kinds.by_behaviour: Start from behaviours and methods: optogenetic or thermogenetic activation of descending neurons that changes walking, stopping, grooming, steering, escape, takeoff, landing or posture.
search_kinds.by_driver_line: Start from the driver-line IDs in driver_lines.csv (split-GAL4 and other DN lines) and search for papers that activated these lines.
search_kinds.by_citation: Start from papers that cite Cande et al. 2018 (the optogenetic DN atlas), Namiki et al. 2018 (the DN driver-line paper) or the 2025 DN driver-line catalogue, and check each for activation experiments.

dedicated_sources_note: The two Pugliese 2026 papers and the 2026 Sapkal preprint are placed only in dedicated rooms (PREREG v2 L7).
